scope: Existing OPA implementations for the first 46 canonical DSCB requirements

mappings.basis: The policy denies direct pushes to protected branches and additionally requires review for protected-branch integration.
For every release candidate the policy requires an SBOM and verifies its link to the releasable artifact.
The policy checks that vulnerability-scan evidence exists for a release candidate.
limitations: It does not prove that scanning ran during the build or test stage.
It does not validate evidence provenance or freshness.

mappings.basis: The policy evaluates critical vulnerabilities for an approved, non-expired waiver.
limitations: The requirement covers all identified vulnerabilities, while the policy evaluates only critical findings.
The policy does not establish that each non-critical finding was evaluated.

mappings.basis: The policy requires digest or signature evidence and checks digest linkage for release candidates.
limitations: It does not verify approved repository integrity controls.
It does not validate a present signature or link that signature to the artifact.

mappings.basis: The policy denies privileged access when MFA is not enforced.
The policy unconditionally denies detected direct external downloads and separately governs unapproved dependency sources.
For PRA-Level 2 release candidates the policy requires a cryptographic artifact signature.
When deployment is required the policy requires an Infrastructure-as-Code repository.
The policy denies an existing IaC repository when it is not version controlled.
The policy requires security gates to be enforced for every release candidate.
The policy blocks a release candidate when security thresholds are exceeded unless waiver evidence exists.
limitations: The rule checks only that approved-waiver evidence exists; it does not validate approval, scope, or expiry.
Full equivalence depends on reliable composition with waiver validation.

mappings.basis: The policy validates fields of waiver records that already have status approved.
limitations: It has no non-compliance input and cannot detect non-compliance without a waiver.
It cannot establish the required link between a non-compliance record and its approved waiver.

mappings.basis: The active canonical statement is incomplete: '[DSCB-GOV-REQ-005]All deviations SHALL:'.
limitations: Semantic equivalence cannot be established against an incomplete requirement.
The policy checks only waiver records whose status is already approved, so other deviations are outside its scope.
